# DSH Java (dsh-java) — Agent Harness

> A self-contained AI Agent Harness built on Java 17 + Spring Boot 3.5.16.
> ReAct loop, real tool execution, human approvals, plugins (Java SPI / Node sidecar / MCP),
> event-sourced sessions, and a zero-build web console.

Key capabilities:
- ReAct agent loop (max 50 steps per turn)
- Tools: file read/write, shell execution, web search/fetch, ask-user
- Plugins: Java native JAR/SPI, Node bridge (JSON-RPC), MCP tools
- Submit-time permission matrix + human approval for high-risk tools
- Event sourcing for sessions, tasks, approvals, goals
- REST + SSE protocol; H2 standalone, MySQL, Docker Compose

Tech stack: Java 17, Spring Boot 3.5.16, MyBatis, Maven
Version: 0.2.3
Repository: https://github.com/linlannet/dsh-java
Related repositories: dsh-java-plugins, dsh-java-desktop, dsh-java-mobile, dsh-java-release

Build: `mvn clean package -DskipTests`
Test:  `mvn test`
Run:   `java -jar dsh-java-app/target/dsh-java-app-0.2.3-exec.jar --spring.profiles.active=standalone`
Console: http://127.0.0.1:8090

Module map:
- dsh-java-domain        domain models, events, ports
- dsh-java-infrastructure adapters (DB, LLM, plugin runtime)
- dsh-java-case          use cases (agent loop, session, task, approval)
- dsh-java-api           API interfaces + DTOs + response envelope
- dsh-java-trigger       HTTP/SSE controllers and filters
- dsh-java-app           Spring Boot application + static web console
- plugins/sample-tools-plugin  sample Java plugin
- plugins/dsh-emis-plugin     linlan-emis identity plugin (RS256 JWKS; whoami/scope_check)
